source.note: Metadata adapted from the audited ECC repository for CAMEO's capability registry. No ECC scripts, hooks, or installers are bundled or executed; CAMEO implements each capability with its own typed tools and security gates.

selection.toolBudget: only CAMEO-owned tools: bounded project snapshot, configured provider chat, allowlisted checks, per-file approved proposals, read-only review workers

capabilities.description: Write a failing test first, implement the smallest change to make it pass, then refactor with coverage intact.
Six-phase verification: build, typecheck, lint, tests, security-relevant grep, and diff review with a real PASS/FAIL report from executed commands only.
Turn a real failing command output into a reproducible defect fix; verify the exact failing phase before completion.
Trust boundaries, secret exposure, unsafe input, destructive behavior, and missing regression tests, reviewed read-only with no execution.
Evidence-based review of correctness, assumptions, and integration risk with concrete file references and no self-approval of produced output.
Decompose a task into 3-6 concrete steps with acceptance criteria and explicit tool/permission needs before any implementation.
Prefer current official library docs and pinned sources over training data; cite the source before relying on a documented API.
Accessible UI feedback: semantic components, keyboard navigation, contrast, target size, and reduced-motion support.
Summarize verified changed files and outcomes; git push, hooks, and remote workflows remain unavailable to agents.
Project-scoped, user-editable memory of decisions, verified fixes, commands, and patterns, with inspect/edit/delete controls and secret redaction.
